name: Uttarakhand Dwarf Pension Scheme
benefit: of the pension. The Uttarakhand government took a very good initiative for the Dwarf people. BenefitsBenefitsThe government provides financial assistance of Rs. 1200/- per month.
eligibility_rules: Applicant height should be below 4 feet for getting benefits of the Dwarf Pension Scheme. The age should be 21 years or more, and the benefit of any other scheme is not being provided under the social security program. Applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand state. There is no provision for a monthly income limit for eligibility under this scheme.
documents_required: List of the required documentsAadhaar card. Bank account details. Passport
certificate issued by Social Welfare Department Officer.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Application ProcessVisit the official website. Download the application form the official website. Fill out the application form with the required details. Attach the necessary documents. Applicants should visit Social Welfare Department in the concerned District/Taluka office to submit the application form.
